messages:
incidents-bot: 🚨 Alert: hosted-api-us-east queue growth detected. GPU pool 'dedicated-us-east-2' at 100% alloc, provisioner failing to create new nodes, backend errors spiking. p95 tok-gen latency 4.2s -> 22s, p99 9.1s -> 48s. backlog ~42k requests.
alex.k: ack — oncall taking. grabbing logs now. any customer-facing throttles in place?
maria_g: looking at autoscaler: create requests are 504 from cloud provider for the last 18m, rate-limit 429 on provisioning API. provisioner retries are exponential and now queued.
emily_r: confirming: route-metrics show sudden 3x traffic from a single keyspace (unknown client ID) starting ~3951235000. many of those requests are long-context completions (seq_len ~4k) — high GPU memory.
jordan_ops: possible hot-shard: requests are concentrated on route /v1/generate/model-x-large; fallback routing not enabled for this customer.
alex.k: mitigation options: 1) apply emergency routing to send new requests to smaller model variant (model-x-small) 2) enable shedding at ingress for heavy contexts 3) temporarily raise autoscaler max (need infra quota approval) 4) create thin-provisioned GPUS (if provisioner will accept).
sam_sre: infra quota team flagged: current project quotas prevent raising pool size beyond 60 nodes in us-east-2. we have ~60 allocated, provider throttling on new VM creations.
emily_r: customer-impact estimate: ~18% of requests are timing out (504 at client), error budget for hosted tier likely breached if not mitigated in 30m. Affected customers: several mid-market customers using model-x-large, and a handful of high-throughput API keys.
alex.k: immediate action: enable circuit-breaker to reject requests with seq_len > 2000 for 15m. route to model-x-small with 90% of traffic for that route. can someone push the routing patch?
maria_g: pushing routing change now. patch:
```json
{
  "route": "/v1/generate/model-x-large",
  "rules": [
    {"match": {"seq_len": ">2000"}, "action": "reject_503"},
    {"action": "route_to", "target": "model-x-small", "pct": 90}
  ]
}
```
Applying in 2m.
incidents-bot: deploy started by maria_g — rollout 10% -> 100% (eta 3m).
jordan_ops: patch applied at 3951236020. seeing immediate drop in queue growth rate. backlog still ~33k but incoming rate reduced by ~45% for long-context requests.
alex.k: enable ingress-level rate-shed for keys with >200rpm, 30s window. that will protect provisioning. who can flip that?
sam_sre: flipping rate-shed now. rule:
```
rate_shed(key, window=30s, threshold=200) -> reject_429
```
Done at 3951236145.
emily_r: metrics: p95 down from 22s -> 9.8s over last 5m, p99 from 48s -> 20s. error rate still at 6%. backlog draining slowly (~1.2k/min).
maria_g: provisioner still seeing 429s from cloud quota API, but there's a small window to create 6 thin-provisioned nodes (thin preemptible) — can we create them manually?
jordan_ops: manual thin nodes require approval; I have creds to create up to 3 thin nodes in the region. spinning up 3 now.
alex.k: do it. also open quick request to cloud-quotas for emergency bump — pinged support with ticket ID CQ-88421.
sam_sre: manual nodes came up at 3951236500. scheduler assigned 12 heavy pods to them, but memory pressure caused OOM on one node; evicted 4 pods. need to adjust pod limits / use smaller variants.
emily_r: rolling fallback for evicted pods to model-x-small is in progress. fallback is preventing new OOMs.
incidents-bot: Customer-impact summary (auto): ~12 customers with degraded latency, 4 customers experiencing >10% request failures, estimated affected p95 overhead for them +200-600ms.
maria_g: mitigation status: routing patch + rate-shed + 3 manual thin nodes + fallback -> backlog trend negative. still watching provisioning 429. recommend temporary customer communication if degradations persist >1h.
alex.k: agree. drafting customer note: short blurb to updates channel and support. @support-team can you prepare a canned message?
oncall-bot: @support-team page created: SUP-3951236789, draft saved.
sam_sre: autoscaler logs show a bug where scale-up loop bails if >5 consecutive 429s — we've hit that path. patch available (hotfix) in staging. need permission to hotpatch on-call-provisioner.
jordan_ops: hotfix tested locally. I can apply to prod provisioner if infra ops gives nod. Expected improvement: more resilient retries and jitter.
emily_r: recommend leave routing and rate-shed in place until autoscaler patch deployed. also add a temporary fallback route for new clients to smaller models by default for 2h.
alex.k: I'm going to hand off to night oncall in 30m. current tasks for handoff: 1) ensure hotfix rollout for provisioner 2) keep routing rules in place 3) monitor backlog <5k target 4) confirm cloud quota ticket escalated.
maria_g: handoff note: hotfix PR #4729, tested; manual deploy steps: ssh to provisioner-ctrl, git checkout hotfix, run ./deploy.sh --prod. Rolling restart ~5m.
sam_sre: I will stay for hotpatch. also looping in quota-owner @infra-quotas.
incidents-bot: Pager escalation: pager to night-oncall (alex.k -> emily_r) scheduled at 3951237000.
emily_r: taking handoff early. I'll coordinate the hotfix and keep a 15m update cadence.
alex.k: thanks — brief timeline for postmortem later: root cause likely provider-side provisioning 429s + provisioner retry logic + concentrated heavy-context traffic to one model variant. mitigation worked: routing + shedding + thin nodes + hotfix.
maria_g: adding note: potential long-term fixes: enable automatic fallback routing for long-contexts, change provisioner retry policy with jitter and backoff cap, and request soft quota increase for region.
incidents-bot: Incident state: mitigated -> partial (backlog decreasing, autoscaler degraded). Next update at 3951237600 or on changes.
emily_r: confirmed backlog at 3951237790: 4.2k requests. p95 now 3.1s, p99 7.6s. error rate 1.4%. handing off to night shift for monitoring and postmortem.
alex.k: thanks all — good coordinated response. I'll draft initial postmortem and runbook updates after 1st stab at RCA.
